title: ‘The Devil's Plan: Dead Again’ Unveils Main Trailer Ahead of November 10 Premiere
summary: The Devil’s Plan: Dead Again brings back the biggest names in Korea’s“brain survival game” format alongside a roster of formidable newcomers, pitting them against each other on an expanded stage packed with new twists
body_markdown:
The Devil’s Plan: Dead Again


brings back the biggest names in Korea’s“brain survival game” format alongside a roster of formidable newcomers, pitting them against each other on an expanded stage packed with new twists — all competing for one ultimate championship. Leading the pack is Jang Dongmin, the undisputed "Survivor King" who holds an unprecedented record of five consecutive survival-show victories. Joining him are battle-tested veterans Hong Jinho, Oh Hyunmin, Ha Seok-jin, Jeong Hyun-gyu, Kim Dong-jae, XITSUH, Yurisa, Hyun Kyunglyul, and John Park. Adding fresh energy to the mix, SHINDONG, JAE JAE, Nucksal, Yi Do, Stella Jang, and hidden powerhouse Jung Wonyoung complete the powerhouse 16-player roster. With Producer Jung Jong-yeon assembling his most intensely driven lineup yet, survival-show fans’ expectations are running high.


The newly released main trailer teases high-stakes mind games and psychological warfare heightened by changes to the rules. Unlike the previous two seasons, running out of Pieces no longer triggers automatic elimination. Instead, each player's fate is dictated strictly by the outcome of the matches. This change frees up movement between the Living Area and the Prison Area, which felt restricted in past seasons, opening the door to far more aggressive tactical play.


Jang Dongmin’s arrival instantly ignites fierce competitive spirit across the board. The atmosphere crackles with tension as some seek alliances with him while others openly target him. Jung Wonyoung sets his sights on breaking up the legendary "Jang-Oh" alliance; meanwhile, a tearful Oh Hyunmin signals a ruthless arena where there are no easy targets. The visual of Jang Dongmin clashing directly with Season 2 champion Jeong Hyun-gyu pushes the high-stakes strategy to a fever pitch.


The fierce determination of these veteran competitors keeps viewers on edge, as their shifting dynamics promise a whirlwind of psychological suspense.


The Devil’s Plan: Dead Again


premieres worldwide on November 10, only on Netflix.
